notes: One closed ledger entry plus the full seven-operation transcript that produced it, one JSON object per line, and the matching ledger.log append lines (ts op dispatch_id actor). The op names are frozen: create-entry, claim, update-status, add-constraint, add-followup, close-out, query. ops.jsonl validates per line, ledger.log per line against the log_line regex. ops.jsonl carries schema null because ledger-entry.schema.json#/$defs/op is the frozen enum of op names, not a record shape: the runner checks each records op field against that enum and treats args as op-specific.
